const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 3;
const MIN_PAGE_SIZE = 1;

  properties: {

    page_size: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }

  additionalProperties: false

    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') throw new Error('cursor must be a string');

    if (!Number.isInteger(args.page_size) || args.page_size < MIN_PAGE_SIZE || args.page_size > MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
      throw new Error('page_size must be an integer between 1 and 3');
    }

  }

  const result = { events: slice };
  const nextStart = start + page_size;
  if (nextStart < events.length) {
    result.next_cursor = encodeCursor(nextStart);
  }
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }] };
}
